newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany asks Brussels to let it decide on Bewag.
newsitem.headline: Germany asks Brussels to let it decide on Bewag.

text.p: The German cartel office said on Friday it has asked that European cartel authorities in Brussels let it rule on the sale of Berlin power company Bewag to a group led by Southern Co of the U.S.
A spokesman for the cartel office said the application was made to the German economics ministry, which must decide whether to pass it on.
German utilities Veba and Viag are part of the group with Southern that has agreed to buy the Berlin government's 50.8 percent stake in Bewag for 2.95 billion marks.

The German cartel office, which has been successful in the past in winning jurisdiction from Brussels in merger cases, has said it is concerned that Veba's other activities in the Berlin region could give a market-dominating position.
